name: load-tests
description: Load testing suite for Garden Backend Service

scripts.test: AUTH_TOKEN=$(npm run -s get-token) artillery run load-test-config.yml
scripts.test:local: AUTH_TOKEN=$(npm run -s get-token) artillery run --target http://localhost:8000 load-test-config.yml
scripts.test:staging: AUTH_TOKEN=$(npm run -s get-token) artillery run --target https://staging-api.example.com load-test-config.yml
scripts.test:ci: AUTH_TOKEN=$(npm run -s get-token) artillery run --output test-results.json load-test-config.yml && artillery report test-results.json
scripts.test:quick: AUTH_TOKEN=$(npm run -s get-token) artillery run --config '{"phases": [{"duration": 30, "arrivalRate": 5}]}' load-test-config.yml
